description: This source file implements functions for interacting with TR-181 parameters, including getting, setting, clearing parameters, and managing local parameter storage with thread safety and logging features.

methods.name: getParam
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value via RFC, populates TR181_ParamData_t.

methods.name: setParam
methods.description: Sets a parameter value via RFC.

methods.name: clearParam
methods.description: Clears a parameter via RFC by setting a special clear parameter.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Reads parameter value from a file.

methods.name: getDefaultValue
methods.description: Retrieves default parameter value from a default ini file.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Stores a parameter value in local store file with thread safety.

methods.name: getLocalParam
methods.description: Retrieves a local parameter with semaphore protection, falls back to default.

methods.name: setLocalParam
methods.description: Sets a local parameter with semaphore protection.

methods.name: clearLocalParam
methods.description: Clears a local parameter with semaphore protection.
